topic: The live orbital race gives each player a gauge with a green safe band between HAMUJ and DOPALAJ, showing when the corrected path returns to DOBRA ORBITA on desktop and phone

provenance.composition: Deterministic AppKit render from social/source/render-orbit-gauge-shows-good-orbit-pack.swift; native observatory art plus real localhost desktop and phone race screens captured with social/source/capture-local-app.swift through WebKit, with no generated UI. The educational claim interprets NASA orbit-balance and apoapsis/periapsis guidance into a child-readable race gauge rather than presenting a literal mission plot.
